|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Jedi Council Chamber or Yoda's Hut. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with “A Jedi's” in title (except A Jedi's Resilience). [Virtual Block 5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them and opponent's [Sidious] Effects here are canceled. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 7, slip 60. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 21). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=21, page 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=21 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “60” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “cancelled” for “canceled” (the block list and the Virtual master list agree on “cancelled” in every capture) (it writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and the icons as “[Virtual Block 5]”, “[Sidious]” and “(Immune to Alter.)”, which is notation only): “Deploy on Jedi Council Chamber or Yoda's Hut. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to take a card with 'A Jedi's' in title (except A Jedi's Resilience) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Virtual Block 5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them and opponent's [Sidious] Effects here are cancelled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1250_60-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-anunusualamountoffear-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on Jedi Council Chamber or Yoda's Hut. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with “A Jedi's” in title (except A Jedi's Resilience). [Virtual Block 5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them and opponent's [Sidious] Effects here are canceled. [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “60” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 21)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on Jedi Council Chamber or Yoda's Hut. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with “A Jedi's” in title (except A Jedi's Resilience). [Virtual Block 5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them and opponent's [Sidious] Effects here are canceled. [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-60-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “60”).
